arStrings.szText: {c_important}Rally's{/c} increases your Movement Speed by an additional {c_number}[{SF_15} * 100|%+|]{/c} and generates {c_number}{SF_14}{/c} additional Faith.
{c_important}Rally{/c} generates {c_number}{SF_13}{/c} more Faith and gains {c_number}{SF_9}{/c} additional Charge.
{c_important}Rally{/c} spends all available Charges, reducing all active {c_important}Justice{/c} Skill Cooldowns by {c_number}{SF_11}{/c} seconds per Charge.
{c_important}Rally{/c} now costs {c_number}[{SF_7} * 100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,PlayerHealthMax() * {SF_7})]){/c} and can stack.
